card.name: Quote mark opening a word's meaning
card.fires_on: An opening quotation mark or parenthesis that comes right before the English gloss of a foreign word in an etymology entry. It follows the Latin or French source word, as in 'from Latin X' followed by the meaning.

modes.label: Gloss quote in etymology
modes.description: The opening quote or bracket that introduces the meaning of a Latin, French or Persian source word.
